title: Origenality Controlled Vocabulary — Approaches
description: Closed enumeration of the angle or method of a publication, as opposed to its subject matter (themes) or its object (works). A notice normally carries one or two approach identifiers. The axis exists so that the density measure can distinguish a saturated theme studied from one angle from a theme genuinely worked over from every side.

philological.label: Philological and text-critical
philological.description: Work on the text itself: manuscripts, recensions, variants, attribution, lexicon, translation technique.

exegetical.label: Exegetical
exegetical.description: Study of how Origen reads a biblical book or passage, or of his exegetical procedures on a given text.

doctrinal.label: Doctrinal and systematic
doctrinal.description: Reconstruction of a doctrine or a theological system, its coherence and its concepts.

historical.label: Historical and contextual
historical.description: Situating Origen or a text in its historical, social, institutional or religious setting.

reception.label: Reception history
reception.description: Study of the later fortune of Origen: readers, translators, controversies, influence, historiography.

comparative.label: Comparative and philosophical
comparative.description: Comparison with another author, tradition or philosophical school, or conceptual analysis in philosophical terms.

methodological.label: Methodological and digital
methodological.description: Work on method, tools, databases, quantitative or digital treatment of the corpus.

edition.label: Edition or translation
edition.description: The publication is itself an edition, a translation, or an annotated edition of an Origenian text.

review.label: Review or notice
review.description: Book review, review article or short bibliographic notice.

survey.label: Survey, reference or collective volume

labels.fr: Synthèse, ouvrage de référence ou volume collectif
labels.it: Sintesi, opera di riferimento o volume collettivo

survey.description: State of the question, handbook or dictionary entry, bibliography, conference proceedings or Festschrift taken as a whole.
